messages:
maria-sec: Heads up — staging restore jobs are failing for a handful of customer backups with KMS decrypt errors. Noticed ~24 objects across two buckets.

devon-sre: Can you paste one of the error lines and the S3 path?

maria-sec: Error sample: ```ERROR: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/backup-uploader is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01```. Path: s3://staging-backups/customer-42/2026-03-19/snap-0003.tar.gz

ashwin: That smells like an IAM/RBAC change. We had a small change to the backup-uploader assume-role last night (PR #5243) to restrict principals.

kelly-eng: yep — I deployed that PR to staging at 2026-03-19T02:15Z. The intent was to disallow cross-account service accounts, but I may have been too strict and removed the uploader SA principal.

maria-sec: Ok. We need containment steps: 1) add temporary grant so restores succeed; 2) run audit to find all affected snapshots; 3) decide if re-encrypt or replay backups.

devon-sre: For quick mitigation we can create a short-lived grant on the CMK to the uploader role. Command: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-backup-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader --operations Decrypt Encrypt --name temp-restore-grant```

ashwin: I'll run that with a 6-hour window. Also suggest we grep CloudTrail for KMS Decrypt errors to enumerate impacted objects: `eventName=Decrypt AND errorCode=AccessDenied AND requestParameters.keyId=alias/staging-backup-cmk`.

kelly-eng: Confirmed — my deployment removed the SA principal binding in the role trust policy. I will rollback the change or add back the SA with the narrower condition.

julia-cs: On the customer side — two restores already failed in PROD? I see one CS ticket from customer-42. We should update status and notify affected customers we have a mitigation in progress.

maria-sec: Good call. @julia-cs please draft a short status update: explain cause (RBAC change), current mitigation (temporary KMS grant + rollback), ETA for full fix (2 hours).

devon-sre: After grant creation, run a dry-run restore on 3 sample objects and confirm checksums. If good, we can schedule a replay for the rest.

ashwin: I'll also run `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/staging-backup-cmk` to ensure the grant exists and capture grantId for audit.

ops-bot: Incident runbook "backup-kms-access-failures" triggered. Page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/backup-kms-access-failures 

kelly-eng: Rolling back the PR now. I will also open a follow-up to add an integration test that validates backup-uploader can assume role + kms Decrypt in staging before rollout.

maria-sec: Action items: ashwin create temp grant (in progress), kelly rollback deploy (in progress), devon run dry-run restores (queued), julia craft customer comms (drafting). I'll own postmortem and audit queries.

julia-cs: Draft ready, posting to status page now. Will target affected customers via email with the ETA.

devon-sre: Dry-run restores succeeded for 3 samples after grant. Checksums match.

ashwin: Grant confirmed: returned grantId=7a1b2c3d. I'll schedule revoke at 6h and attach the audit entry.

maria-sec: Good — we should still do a full enumeration of snapshots that hit AccessDenied and queue replays. I'll collect CloudTrail query results and attach to the postmortem.

kelly-eng: Creating a ticket for integration test and a changelog gating rule for future RBAC edits. Ticket: ENG-4289.

maria-sec: Closing loop: mitigation worked, customers notified, rollback in place, follow-ups assigned. Will write timeline + root-cause in postmortem later today. :thumbsup:
